Step into the world of logistics as a Order picker at Albert Heijn Distribution Center located in Tilburg. This is your chance to join a dynamic team, develop your skills, and enjoy real growth opportunities in a modern warehouse environment. Good work! 
Over de functie 
As an Order Picker at Albert Heijn, you help ensure that stores are supplied with the right products on time. Your work mainly consists of picking and preparing orders based on voice instructions received through a headset in English or Dutch. You will be active throughout the warehouse, using EPT trucks and handling goods in different areas, including temperature-controlled sections. The role is dynamic and physical, requiring focus, accuracy, and a steady working pace. 
Your daily responsibilities include: 
- Picking products according to voice instructions - Operating EPT/BT equipment - Building stable pallets ready for transport - Working in both normal and chilled warehouse zones - Following safety rules and maintaining work quality 
You'll work in rotating 2-shift patterns: night and morning shift. 
Full-time and part-time options are available, with at least 32 hours per week. Flexibility to work different shifts, including weekends, is required.

The company plays a key role in the Dutch retail market, supplying fresh food and daily essentials to households across the country.The atmosphere in the warehouse is friendly and supportive, with many opportunities for development. Employees who show initiative and strong performance can grow within the company and advance into roles such as trainer or team leader.
